scope: Independent Home real-Library readiness, original HTTP/schema/catalog/Note/hierarchy/SSE contracts, Home action and READ-authority semantics. Editor owns separate liveness/cleanup/parameter-isolation review; Root owns publication custody and synthesis.

findingClosure.sourceCause: Fixture documentReads increments when a request is received. Its response, account/lease postflight and MainActor publication follow. The observer can increment documentsReadEpoch and retire open's earlier result, allowing the old predicate to return before allDocuments publishes.
findingClosure.correctedSource: The original bounded MainActor predicate now requires both initialObservationReachedConsumer and subject.allDocuments.map(\.id) == [server.objectID].
findingClosure.qualification: Resolves the identified missing-publication wait. It proves observer refresh entry plus actual expected model publication; it does not assert that the second query specifically supplied that publication if the first already did.

findingClosure.sourceCause: The do-scoped model was not test-owned across the later drain while lifetime callbacks capture it weakly.
findingClosure.correctedSource: An outer optional retains the actual model and is used by withExtendedLifetime immediately after await lifetime.drain. No replacement model or readiness setter is introduced.
findingClosure.qualification: Four-literal delta independently checked; complete liveness/cleanup review remains Editor's separate scope.

readinessCounterProof.exactCounterSource: Fixture only increments documentReads for its exact documentsQuery. Hierarchy queries increment hierarchyReads separately.
readinessCounterProof.setupRoutes: Wiki schema uses installed bundle/collection/properties GETs. Note bootstrap reads its derived bundle and verifies the actual collection through the public marker verifier.
readinessCounterProof.catalogRoutes: Catalog reads types/collections and native document-type GET proof. The one controlled Page has no imported Bookmark candidate, so availableBookmarkTypes returns without another object query.
readinessCounterProof.hierarchyInitial: Repository.snapshot reads the distinct wiki-membership query; an empty complete hierarchy is legitimate for the separate ordinary document row.
readinessCounterProof.subscription: AnyHTTPHierarchyRecordStore.watch -> subscribeObjectQuery -> actual ready/snapshot SSE parser -> AnyQueryWindow -> AnyHierarchyRepository.watch. The repository yields only actual upstream updates and checks the first update is initial; no synthesized initial row is used.
readinessCounterProof.consumer: Library.startObservation accepts the snapshot then calls refreshAllDocuments. Empty snapshot types cannot take the unknown-type catalog-refresh branch.
readinessCounterProof.exclusivity: Only one public open occurs before readiness. No test calls refresh/search. Thus the second exact documents query requires observation-consumer entry; it does not independently prove response completion.
readinessCounterProof.correctedBarrier: The source now waits for both that entry and real published expected allDocuments IDs before Home actions.

homeActionReview.publicConstruction: Public session.connect performs current account/health checks. Public nativeAccountRunBinding decodes the d1 binding against controlled account/network. Original creators use the unchanged rejecting journal.
homeActionReview.readiness: Real Library.open constructs the schema/marker/operations/catalog/repository and accepts the actual hierarchy; isReady is never set or bypassed.
homeActionReview.admission: Library.beginHomeAction requires active lifetime, isReady, matching workspace and no current task. Original request identity, session.perform and read-lease checks remain in the exercised path.
homeActionReview.authority: Both controlled roles traverse original currentRead: lease, native account/run, exact member identity and .read. Reader leaves canWrite false while Home preferences remain usable. This is consumer policy coverage, not Native ACL certification.
homeActionReview.set: Actual prepareHome(.object) validates current object. Actual commitHome dispatches the dedicated bound settings PATCH; fixture requires exact expected-account/run headers and one-field canonical string, returns bound204, then actual readHome verifies current state.
homeActionReview.open: Actual readHome and requireHomeDestination revalidate the same object before the model invokes onOpenDocument(objectID,nil). Assertions inspect callback IDs and nil block without constructing an editor.
homeActionReview.unsetAndAbsent: Actual unset sends only pinkhaHomeV1 in the unset array. Actual absent reread leaves callback count unchanged and reports the existing absent-state message.
homeActionReview.mutationBoundary: Exactly two bound settings dispatches are accepted. All other mutation routes, object/schema creation and unbound settings changes fail. Original journal records an issue on any accidental use.
homeActionReview.evidencePrecision: Messages and fixture counters supplement actual public method results. No Home buttons, SwiftUI mounting, native backend, imported context, cold persistence or visual language matrix is claimed.
